note_en: 一……就…… links two actions so that the second follows immediately whenever the first happens: 一听到电钻的声音就浑身发抖 "the moment I hear the sound of the drill, I start shaking all over." English needs a full clause with "as soon as" or "the moment," while Chinese simply puts 一 before the first verb and 就 before the second, with no subject repeated.
